fields.finding: The seven-screen minimum omits unresolved assembly modes; the filed coated swing is 0.917 and a separate scalar scarf interaction is 0.980.
fields.proposed_fix: Maintain a complete mode/load-case ledger, distinguish day-rise from night-reference assembly and map core thermal shear to scarf/bond stresses before combining them. Do not present seven-screen unity as installed-hull unity.
